The Shop

A proper barbershop, the classic way

Legends Room Barbershop is a premium barbershop in Fleetwood, Surrey, BC — a place where a haircut is a ritual, not a rush. Settle into the chair for sharp cuts, careful beard work and the timeless finish of a hot towel shave.

  • Precision cutsMen's haircuts and full grooming packages, finished with care.
  • Beard & shave craftBeard trims, line ups and traditional hot towel shaves.
  • For every generationKids' and seniors' cuts, seven days a week.
